constraints: s and t are English letters (case-sensitive).
hints: Write the check "does s[l..r] contain t?" first. Brute force tries every window.
If s[l..r] is valid, so is every window that contains it. So once valid, try to shrink from the left.
Track `have` = how many distinct characters currently meet their required count. Valid iff have == required.

insight.mnemonic: Stretch to cover, squeeze to minimize.
insight.oneLiner: Grow r until the window covers t, then advance l as far as it stays valid; record the best each time.
insight.pattern: Expand until valid, shrink while valid

recall.a: Distinct characters of t whose count in the window has reached the required count.
When removing s[l] drops its count below what t requires.

insight.why: The have/required counter makes validity an O(1) check, and both pointers move only forward: O(|s| + |t|).

oneLiner: Grow r until the window covers t, then advance l as far as it stays valid; record the best each time.

pitfalls.explain: If t = "aab", the window needs two a's. Compare counts, not just membership.
pitfalls.title: Ignored repeated letters in t

pitfalls.explain: Keep shrinking from the left while the window stays valid.
pitfalls.title: Returned a valid but longer window

solutions.idea: For each start, extend until the window covers t.
solutions.name: Shortest valid window per start

footnotes.text: Expand until valid, then shrink while still valid. Each index enters the window once (r) and leaves once (l), so this is O(|s| + |t|) despite the nested loop.

solutions.idea: Expand right until valid, then shrink left while valid, tracking satisfied requirements.
solutions.name: Sliding window with have/need

starter:
class Solution:
    def minWindow(self, s: str, t: str) -> str:
statement:
Given strings `s` and `t`, return the **shortest substring of `s` that contains every character of `t`**, counting duplicates (if `t` has two `a`s, the window needs at least two).

If no such substring exists, return `""`. When several shortest windows exist, any of them is accepted.
title: Minimum Window Substring
